items.title: Clicks vs clients
items.script: Most people judge an ad by clicks. Clicks are cheap and they prove nothing. The number that matters is cost per booked consultation. Track the whole path, from the first click to the signed client, or you are guessing with real money.

items.title: What a Meta Pixel is
items.script: A Meta Pixel is a small piece of code on your website. It tells Meta what a visitor did, like viewing a page or booking a call. Meta uses that to find more people like them. No pixel, no learning, and the algorithm is flying blind.

items.title: The first three seconds
items.script: On social, people decide almost instantly whether to keep watching. Your opening has to earn the next few seconds. Lead with the problem or the surprising result, not your logo. Put the context after you have their attention.
